'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Reid Smith DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' R. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Neidtech Rops 2010
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
